thread:
maya: Deploybot finished rollout v3.5.7 -> prod at 2026-03-02T18:20:00Z. Quick synthetic heartbeat in eu-west-2 shows p95 spike ~180ms; p50 normal. KV and prefill checks green. Who can triage?

deploy-bot: rollout v3.5.7 complete (rollout_id=rl-3f8) :white_check_mark:

owen: on it. running quick smoke: `./ops/smoketest --probe heartbeat --region eu-west-2 --window 7m --raw`

priya: FYI I shipped a micro-optimization to the tokenizer flow in this release. Could be related to long-sequence perf.

owen: quickcheck output: p50=46ms, p95=179ms, p99=290ms, errors=0.09%. Tail moved but errors low.

maya: not a full rollback candidate. Suggest an in-region traffic-weight override to shift most traffic back to v3.5.6 while keeping some sampling on v3.5.7. Keep TTL short (15m) while we gather traces.

owen: agree. applying weight override: `redwood route override --region eu-west-2 --weights v3.5.6=0.85,v3.5.7=0.15 --ttl 15m --reason "postdeploy tail increase"`

sre-bot: route override applied by owen at 2026-03-02T18:24:12Z (TTL 15m).

priya: kicking off expanded synth with long prompts and high-token outputs. Command: `./ops/smoketest --profile long-tail --region eu-west-2 --duration 12m`

owen: short-run after override (5m): p95=130ms, p99=230ms, errors=0.07%  improvement but still above baseline (~95ms).

maya: that suggests variant contributes. Priya, can you run tokenizer microbench and post delta across variants? Also enable 0.5% debug sampling for tokenization timing in traces.

priya: running bench now. Will post link when ready.

nowen: synth finished: for sampled v3.5.7 traffic p95=145ms; v3.5.6 sample p95=96ms.

priya: bench link: https://internal/perf/tokenize/20260302-v3.5.7-diff - tokenize p95 +30ms on sequences >2k tokens. Small inputs unaffected. Looks like the micro-opt created a regresssion on long contexts.

maya: decision: targeted rollback in-region to restore SLOs. We'll apply v3.5.6=1.0 override for 60m in eu-west-2, keep global rollout paused. Priya to prepare revert/hotfix and CI perf test. Owen to apply override.

owen: applying: `redwood route override --region eu-west-2 --weights v3.5.6=1.0 --ttl 60m --reason "in-region rollback - tokenizer perf reg"`

ops-bot: route override applied (eu-west-2 -> v3.5.6=100%) by owen at 2026-03-02T18:40:03Z. TTL 60m.

nowen: post-rollback quickcheck (5m): p95=98ms, p99=140ms, errors=0.02%  back to baseline.

priya: opening PR with revert + perf test that fails if tokenize p95 increases >10ms on long contexts. Will target v3.5.8.

maya: update release notes with incident note and notify CS/Support in case customers saw degraded tail. We'll monitor for 2h then lift TTL. Closing thread unless regressions. :white_check_mark:
